projects.name: nibli
projects.desc: Zero-hallucination symbolic reasoning engine — a hallucination firewall for the LLM era. Lojban in, first-order logic out; a proof trace on every conclusion.

projects.name: cognito
projects.desc: Pure-Rust System 2 reasoning kernel — minimal knowledge, maximal logic. A transformer on Burn that thinks in explicit steps.

projects.name: hostscli
projects.desc: Python CLI that blocks and unblocks websites straight from /etc/hosts. Sometimes the best firewall is a text file.

projects.name: awesome-rust-ml
projects.desc: A curated map of the Rust machine-learning ecosystem. Curation is also building: someone has to keep the index honest.

projects.name: Appknox
projects.desc: Mobile-app security scanning at scale — static, dynamic, and API analysis. Software Architect on the platform.

projects.name: NuFlights
projects.desc: Airline retailing on the NDC standard — adapters translating between carriers speaking different dialects of the same spec. Rust and Python doing protocol work.

projects.name: the Reckonsys years
projects.desc: VP of Engineering, ~70% hands-on by choice. Python and Rust microservices for startups, teams of five to fifteen.

projects.name: ReWire
projects.desc: One of the first interactive meditation apps (2011) — train focus and presence using your own music, on an iPhone.

authored.title: The Fixed Point of Thought
authored.blurb: A book on symbolic reasoning for builders — the ideas behind nibli: how logic, recursion, and self-reference become real, running systems. Equal parts Gödel, Rust, and lab notebook. (Working title; drafting in the open.)

authored.title: Utopia, Reimagined
authored.blurb: Optimistic nihilism applied to coordination, economics, and freedom — a from-first-principles re-derivation of what a good society could compute.

reviewed.title: Programming WebAssembly with Rust
reviewed.author: Kevin Hoffman
reviewed.note: Solid foundations; the ecosystem has since moved on.

reviewed.title: Gödel, Escher, Bach
reviewed.author: Douglas Hofstadter
reviewed.note: The strange loop that rewired me. Re-reading, again.

musings.title: On building things that outlive their meaning
musings.excerpt: The universe doesn't owe your software a reason to exist — the most freeing license a builder can be handed.

musings.title: Gödel, the halting problem, and why I sleep fine
musings.excerpt: What undecidability actually means for the systems we build — and the strange comfort in provable limits.

musings.title: தமிழில் நிரலாக்கம் — thinking in two scripts
musings.excerpt: Reasoning across English and Tamil, and what bilingual thought taught me about naming things in code.

about.tagline: An Optimistic Nihilist who loves Science, Rust, Python, FOSS, WebAssembly, WebRTC, Web3, Distributed Systems, and symbolic reasoning.
about.bio: Hands-on software architect, lifelong builder. Bangalore, India. I care about correctness, freedom, and code that still makes sense in a decade. Not an entrepreneur — I just want to build the things.
